name: The Dodo

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); leader of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.species: dodo (Raphus cucullatus), reconstructed from the modern scientific consensus: grey-brown plumage, not the fat 'Tenniel' cartoon
rendering.limits: Bird anatomy throughout; speech by beak and throat movement. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.reason: The source calls the Dodo 'it'; index.json registers him male. His pompous committee-chairman manner (ch003) and solemn presentation speech (ch003-p28) read as an elder gentleman.

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (elder statesman of the party), kept for voice casting. As an animal: a mature, heavy adult bird with slightly worn tail plumes.

hair.color: brownish-grey body, paler grey-white at the throat and belly, dark grey wing stubs, a tuft of curly pale-grey tail plumes
hair.style: loose, soft, slightly shaggy plumage; draggled and dripping on arrival, fluffing out after the race
hair.reason: Draggled state sourced; colours follow the dodo reconstruction.

eyes.expression: small, round, set far back on the head, self-important; blinks slowly while thinking
eyes.reason: Not described; small eyes against the massive beak give the dodo read.

skin.tone: bare grey facial skin around the eye and beak base; yellow-green legs and feet

face.shape: large head with a massive hooked beak, pale greenish-yellow with a darker hooked tip
face.shakespeare_pose: sits for a long time with one wing-tip pressed to its forehead
face.quote: it sat for a long time with one finger pressed upon its forehead (the position in which you usually see Shakespeare, in the pictures of him)
face.reason: The sourced 'finger' becomes a wing-tip on a bird body.

build.posture: chest out, head up; waddling deliberate walk; ceremonious slow bows
build.scale_reference: The largest of the pool-bank party. With Alice shrunk for the pool (SUP-003) he stands about her height or a little under; he is the one who hands her the thimble beak-to-hand.
build.quote: the Dodo solemnly presented the thimble

entry_state.state: first seen dripping wet, feathers plastered, on the bank of the pool
entry_state.quote: all dripping wet, cross, and uncomfortable

marks.description: one wing-tip pressed to the forehead in the Shakespeare pose
Alice's own thimble, presented back to her as her prize, held in the beak

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: he wears nothing; his look is the grey-brown plumage
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives the Dodo no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old frock-coat reading is dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal dodo bird, scientifically reconstructed, brownish-grey loose plumage wet and draggled, pale grey belly, massive hooked pale yellow-green beak with a dark tip, small pale yellow eye, bare grey face patch, tiny wings, curly tail tuft, stout yellow legs, standing solemnly on a muddy pool bank with one wing-tip pressed to its forehead, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
